repo.name: my-awesome-skills
repo.tagline_en: A curated collection of reusable skills for AI coding agents. Each skill lives in its own directory under `skills/` and can be used independently.
repo.tagline_zh: 一组可复用的 AI 编程助手技能合集。每个技能独立存放在 `skills/` 下的目录中，可单独使用。

skills.summary_en: Design, PR/MR review and preference-learning standard: independent cross-validation, small requests, justified complexity, credential boundaries and observable verification, with `plan` / `create` / `merge` / `review` / `learn` workflows.
skills.summary_zh: 方案、PR/MR 评审与偏好学习标准：独立交叉验证、小变更、有依据的复杂度、凭证边界和可观察行为验证，包含 plan / create / merge / review / learn 流程。

skills.summary_en: Turn a course's full materials (slides, lecture videos/audio, transcripts, readings, assignments and solutions) into a high-density online textbook in the style of textbook.cs161.org: mdBook, bilingual, deployed to GitHub Pages, with real-render verification.
skills.summary_zh: 把一门课的全套材料（课件 PDF、讲课视频/音频、字幕转录、每讲 readings、作业与解答）转换成 textbook.cs161.org 风格的可精读在线教材：mdBook、可双语切换、部署到 GitHub Pages，并以真实渲染做核验。
